title: Ozymandosis | The Bioluminescent RTS
author: francoperdu
selftext:
I'm a recovering sysadmin who quit the industry years ago. After a long sanity break with tech, I made a video game after months of learning to wield this new technology. I had hoped my IRL communities would have been interested in this, but they mostly just condescended and put me down. Maybe y'all would like this more  
  
  
[https://ozymandosis.com/](https://ozymandosis.com/)  
  
  
Ozymandosis is a bioluminescent real-time strategy game, set in a drop of water. You start with one lineage of creatures; they feed, divide and change, and evolve as you play the game.  
  
There's a full single-player game as well as multiplayer with people in the same house over your own Wi-Fi AND global online matches.  
  
It's a closed beta, Android only for now (iOS and Steam coming soon). It costs $1 to install. Google makes me charge for a beta, if you hate it I will give you your dollar back :)  
  
There are two steps, in this order, and please use the same Google account for both:  
  
1. Join the group: [https://groups.google.com/g/ozymandosis-beta](https://groups.google.com/g/ozymandosis-beta)  
2. Then open this on your Android phone and accept: [https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.ozymandosis.game](https://play.google.com/apps/testing/com.ozymandosis.game)  
  
It has to be the same Google account, or Google will tell you you're not a tester. And the phone's Google account needs a working payment method, since the app is paid.  
  
THIS IS IMPORTANT: Please stay opted-in for at least 2 weeks or Google won't count it. AND I WANT YOUR FEEDBACK! As you play i'd love to hear your thoughts on how to improve this.  
  
Oh yeah and it's a beta — expect bugs, and expect ratings or saved progress to be reset occasionally while I work on it. Please tell me anything that breaks.
